@graph.name: Rajadamnern Stadium Seat Map
@graph.description: View the Rajadamnern Stadium seat map, seating plan and section locations. See where Ringside, Club Class, LEO Section and Third Class sit around the ring.

primaryImageOfPage.caption: Rajadamnern Stadium seating map showing Ringside Sections 3 to 7, Club Class Sections 8 and 9, LEO Section 10 and Third Class Section 11 around the Muay Thai ring

acceptedAnswer.text: Ringside seats are on the floor around the ring in Sections 3 to 7.

mainEntity.name: Which sections are closest to the fighter entrance?

acceptedAnswer.text: Sections 3 and 4 are closest to the raised fighter entrance walkway, which runs between and through those sections.
Club Class is in Sections 8 and 9 on the elevated main-arena tier.
LEO is Section 10 on the elevated main-arena tier, facing the front of the ring.
Third Class is Section 11 at the highest point of Rajadamnern Stadium.

mainEntity.name: Which section is closest to the ring?

acceptedAnswer.text: Ringside is the closest public seating to the ring.

mainEntity.name: Which section has the widest view?

acceptedAnswer.text: Third Class gives you the widest view across the stadium because it is at the highest point of the building.
Yes. Every ticket guarantees a seat. There are no standing areas at Rajadamnern Stadium.

mainEntity.name: What is the difference between assigned and unassigned seating?

acceptedAnswer.text:
Assigned seating gives you a numbered position.

Unassigned seating means you choose your position within the ticketed section, while still having a seat guaranteed.

mainEntity.name: Does the seating map show exact seat numbers?

acceptedAnswer.text: The seating map shows section locations. It does not guarantee a specific row or seat number.

mainEntity.name: Which seat class should I choose?

acceptedAnswer.text: That depends on the experience you want. Use the seating comparison page to compare Ringside, Club Class, LEO Section and Third Class.

mainEntity.name: Is the stadium larger than it looks on the map?

acceptedAnswer.text: The main arena is compact, so the different seating areas are closer to the ring than photographs often suggest.
